contexts.text: As they do not believe (this) it is a scandal (or stumbling block) to them... When they think that the Lord became a man... they fill the sphere with scandals, because this had been a scandal to them (here).
When the Lord was merely named, they at once filled the sphere with mere scandals...
The Gentiles... have formed no... scandals against the Lord, like many Christians who have led a life of evil. HH 321.
They think about His Human as of that of another man: hence (their) scandals.
If thy right eye shall cause thee to stumble, pluck it out () = that this affection is to be mastered if it causes to stumble.
This emissary babbled scandalous things, chiefly against the Lord, so that he was as it were composed of mere scandals.
To many His Human is a scandal (or stumbling block) because they distinguish it from the Divine. AC 4692:4. AC 4733:end.
By the foot which is to be cut off if it scandalizes () is meant the Natural, which constantly opposes itself to the Spiritual, and which is to be destroyed if it endeavours to infringe upon truths.
It is of no consequence from whom the voice of good and truth flows forth, provided their life is not manifestly wicked, for this scandalizes (or causes people to stumble).
The general of thought of many Spirits concerning the Lord as born a man consisted of mere scandals.
The scandals of Christian Spirits against the Lord.
Hence the Lord said... to the disciples, All ye shall be offended against Me in this night ().
(Origin of) scandalous thoughts concerning the holy things of the Church. SE 4627:5.
Man is then withdrawn from the influx of scandalous and filthy things.
If Jehovah were now to appear in the Church as a Man, they would be scandalized.
European Spirits (then) injected direful scandals... AC 8545.
The Lord expressed an affection of evil by the right eye scandalizing; and an affection of falsity by the right hand scandalizing.
To stumble = to be scandalized, and thus to lapse from truths into falsities.
A stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence = scandalization... For all the proud are not only scandalized, but ensnared, by the fact that the Divine has appeared in a human form...
Some Christians poured in various scandals, but they disregarded them.

Who taught Balak to cast a stumbling block before the sons of Israel () = those who do hypocritical works (to the injury of) the worship of God... The counsel which Balaam gave was the stumbling block... AE 140, Explained.
That the things which follow may be a scandal (or stumbling block) to them. Signified.
Their utterances, which are scandals against the Divine Itself and the Divine Human, and at the same time against everything of the Church... Signified, Explained.
Scandals against the Lord's Celestial Church, and against Heaven. Signified.
(This) may be a stumbling block to those who think about the Divine Providence...
The identity of the three Divine essences is an offence to reason. Signified.
That the intellectual life of some is composed of mere scandals. - That scandals (or offences) must come, is predicted in the Word...
On an odour of scandals.
(This penalty was inflicted on him) before the Spirits... to whom he had presented a scandal (or stumbling block). Described.
In a perverted state, nudities cannot even be mentioned, for they at once give rise to scandals, because the loves are filthy.
That it must needs be that offences come. Explained.

For man is composed of mere scandals... This scandal was as it were almost continuous with the antediluvians. With (the postdiluvians) there was made what is discrete... which would not have been done unless the scandals had remained with man; and therefore the Lord also was made a scandal to them... and therefore He suffered... in order that the scandals might remain; for otherwise so continuous a scandal could never have been rendered discrete, and man be saved by the insertion of scientifics and intellectual things, so that the scandals should not appear.
How dangerous it is to instruct others concerning evils, or to make stumbling blocks for anyone. Explained.
His life (here) had been scandalous. Described.
Besides many other things which are scandals.
(In spiritual temptation, the Spirits who are in falsities) continually pour in scandals (or stumbling blocks) against the truths of faith...
The right eye causing to stumble = the understanding thinking evil. AE 600:8.
If thy right hand shall cause thee to stumble cut it off () = that if he wills what is evil, this of the will is to be shaken off.
All scandalization (or causing to stumble) is done by evil, and not by falsity unless it is the falsity of evil.
Those in faith without charity cause themselves to stumble, from the fact that the Lord suffered Himself to be crucified, and therefore it is called a stumbling block.
He who shall cause to stumble one of the little ones who believe in Me () = to pervert those who acknowledge the Lord.
(Scandals caused by obscene representations there.)
